_comment: REFERENCE — every key the script reads, in one file, so you can see what
is available. To start a repo off, copy the closest file from templates/
instead; this one turns everything on at once.
Every key is optional — create-worktree auto-detects Docker, nginx and the
database, and skips whatever it cannot find. A repo with no Dockerfile gets
The values below are quarterback's, but note that quarterback's real
.worktree.json (repo root) sets docker.enabled=false and does not pin the
Postgres container — because its docker-compose.yml is tracked in git and
the Docker path would overwrite it. Read that file too.
